summary: Sandhills lookout of the J. Clark Salyer NWR, a steel tower dated 1937-38 by West Lookouts and later demolished; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Demolished; the directory gives no date, and the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as removed

events.note: Steel tower erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps, dated 1937-38 by West Lookouts
A cabin was moved to the lookout site in September 1937 to serve as overnight lodging
A telephone line was constructed from the refuge headquarters to the Sandhill tower in December 1938

resolved_conflicts.explanation: West Lookouts spells the refuge Sayler; the Forest Fire Lookout Association and the Fish and Wildlife Service use Salyer, so the story follows the Fish and Wildlife Service spelling

sources.title: J. Clark Salyer National Wildlife Refuge: About Us

notes_for_editor: The 1937-38 build, the CCC attribution and the 1937 and 1938 entries rest on one directory, West Lookouts. A search summary for this tower could not confirm the 1937 date or the CCC work, so treat the build details as single-sourced. No source gives a demolition date. Staffing and fire history: none found, so left out. No source describes the site today, and the refuge wildlife-watching page did not mention a Sandhills tower. The Fish and Wildlife Service observation-tower page returned HTTP 503 on the read, and no source ties any current observation tower to the Sandhills site, so none is connected here. Photos: none found for this tower. The refuge HQ record covers the same refuge and the 1967 renaming.
